applications.name: Playing Favorites
applications.description: At the start of the fight, the Defender chooses 1 type of Basic Attack: Light, Medium or Heavy. Depending on the Basic Attack chosen, the Attacker gains +100% Attack and +100% Ability Accuracy for that Attack and -100% Attack and Ability Accuracy for the remaining two. Whenever either Champion activates a Special Attack, the Defender will choose a new Basic Attack.
applications.rawDescription: At the start of the fight, the Defender chooses 1 type of Basic Attack: Light, Medium or Heavy. Depending on the Basic Attack chosen, the Attacker gains +{1}% Attack and +{2}% Ability Accuracy for that Attack and -{0}% Attack and Ability Accuracy for the remaining two. Whenever either Champion activates a Special Attack, the Defender will choose a new Basic Attack.

applications.name: Energy Adoption: Fire - 1
applications.description: The Defender has a 50% chance to inflict the Attacker with Incinerate each time the Defender is struck or the Attacker blocks an attack. These effects will not trigger while the Defender is suffering from a Bleed Debuff.\nThe Defender also takes 100% reduced damage from Incinerate effects and gains a Regeneration Buff healing 1% of max health per second until the Incinerate expires.
applications.rawDescription: The Defender has a {1}% chance to inflict the Attacker with Incinerate each time the Defender is struck or the Attacker blocks an attack. These effects will not trigger while the Defender is suffering from a Bleed Debuff.\nThe Defender also takes {0}% reduced damage from Incinerate effects and gains a Regeneration Buff healing {2}% of max health per second until the Incinerate expires.

applications.name: Special Burst Lock Down - 3
applications.description: When the Defender activates a Special Attack, the Attacker is inflicted with a Heal Block and an Armor Break Debuff reducing Armor Rating by 40%, each lasting 15 seconds.
applications.rawDescription: When the Defender activates a Special Attack, the Attacker is inflicted with a Heal Block and an Armor Break Debuff reducing Armor Rating by {1}%, each lasting {2} seconds.

applications.name: Crisis of Opportunity
applications.description: Every 20 second(s), the Attacker is afflicted with a Degeneration Passive, dealing 100% of the Defender's Attack Rating over 6 second(s). If the timer expires while the Attacker is performing a Special Attack 1 or 2, instead of being Degenerated, they gain a Fury Passive increasing their Attack Rating by 200% for 12 second(s). If the timer expires while the Defender is performing a Special Attack 1 or 2, the Attacker is still Degenerated and the Defender gains the Fury Passive instead.
applications.rawDescription: Every {1} second(s), the Attacker is afflicted with a Degeneration Passive, dealing {2}% of the Defender's Attack Rating over 6 second(s). If the timer expires while the Attacker is performing a Special Attack 1 or 2, instead of being Degenerated, they gain a Fury Passive increasing their Attack Rating by {0}% for 12 second(s). If the timer expires while the Defender is performing a Special Attack 1 or 2, the Attacker is still Degenerated and the Defender gains the Fury Passive instead.

applications.name: Biohazard
applications.description: When the Defender is struck, there is a 20% chance to inflict the Attacker with a [k=glossary/bleed]Bleed[/k] Debuff. When the Defender Blocks an attack, there is a 50% chance to inflict a [k=glossary/poison]Poison[/k] Debuff. Each deals 100% of the Defender's Attack as Direct Damage over 7.50 seconds.
applications.rawDescription: When the Defender is struck, there is a 20% chance to inflict the Attacker with a [k=glossary/bleed]Bleed[/k] Debuff. When the Defender Blocks an attack, there is a 50% chance to inflict a [k=glossary/poison]Poison[/k] Debuff. Each deals {1}% of the Defender's Attack as Direct Damage over {2} seconds.

applications.name: Powerful From Afar

applications.name: Hazard Shift - Incinerate, Poison
applications.description: Striking the Defender has a 40% chance to inflict the Attacker with an Incinerate Debuff, dealing 30% of the Defender's Attack in Damage over 7 second(s). Every 12 second(s), this is swapped for a chance to inflict Poison instead.
applications.rawDescription: Striking the Defender has a {0}% chance to inflict the Attacker with an Incinerate Debuff, dealing {1}% of the Defender's Attack in Damage over 7 second(s). Every {2} second(s), this is swapped for a chance to inflict Poison instead.

applications.name: Juggling Act - Coldsnap/Incinerate
applications.description: The Attacker starts the fight with an indefinite [k=glossary/coldsnap]Coldsnap[/k] Immunity Passive. Whenever the Attacker charges a Heavy Attack, the Immunity changes to [k=glossary/incinerate]Incinerate[/k]. At the end of the Attacker's Special Attacks, the Immunity changes back to Coldsnap.
applications.rawDescription: The Attacker starts the fight with an indefinite [k=glossary/coldsnap]Coldsnap[/k] Immunity Passive. Whenever the Attacker charges a Heavy Attack, the Immunity changes to [k=glossary/incinerate]Incinerate[/k]. At the end of the Attacker's Special Attacks, the Immunity changes back to Coldsnap.

applications.name: Fractured Guard - 2
applications.description: The Attacker is inflicted with an Indefinite 10% Armor Break Debuff when Blocking the Defender's attacks. When the Attacker activates a Special Attack they remove 1 of these Armor Break Debuffs for each Bar of Power spent.
applications.rawDescription: The Attacker is inflicted with an Indefinite {1}% Armor Break Debuff when Blocking the Defender's attacks. When the Attacker activates a Special Attack they remove 1 of these Armor Break Debuffs for each Bar of Power spent.

applications.name: Schadenfreude - 3
applications.description: Each time the Attacker is inflicted with any Debuff, the Defender gains a Fury Buff granting [16982bff]480%[-] Attack Rating for 10 seconds. This Fury does not stack multiple times.
applications.rawDescription: Each time the Attacker is inflicted with any Debuff, the Defender gains a Fury Buff granting [16982bff]{1}%[-] Attack Rating for {2} seconds. This Fury does not stack multiple times.
